text.title: Database Design (PostgreSQL) Procedure
text.summary: 5-step procedure to produce a Database Design (PostgreSQL) artefact from typed inputs.

step.name: gather
step.action: Confirm every prerequisite is present and recent. Refuse to proceed if any are missing.
step.output: inputs.json with typed entries for each prerequisite
step.decision-gate: Any prerequisite missing - exit with reason; do not synthesize.

step.name: analyse
step.action: Parse + classify each input against the core rules. Tag known vs unknown values. Compute any derived metric the contract requires.

step.name: draft
step.action: Compose draft decision + rationale referencing at least one input by name. Apply allowed-transformations from 02-output-contract.xml.

step.name: self-check
step.action: Run the self-check checklist from 02-output-contract.xml. Match against forbidden patterns and the failure modes in 03-failure-modes.xml. If any hit, fix and re-check.
step.decision-gate: If any forbidden pattern still matches after one fix attempt - escalate to human.

step.name: emit
step.action: Set artefact_id with prefix `dbd-`, version=1.0.0 (or bump if updating an existing record), last_reviewed=today. Validate against templates/database-design.json. Emit.
step.output: final artefact + status flag for owner review

section.title: Schema-authoring sub-procedure (expands steps 2 and 3 when the artefact ships real DDL)

step.name: model-entities-and-relationships
step.action: Translate entities to tables; identify FKs, lookup tables and junction tables; pick PKs (UUID v7 or BIGINT identity — globally, per r-pk-type-global).

step.name: author-ddl-with-constraints
step.action: Emit CREATE TABLE statements with every FK, UNIQUE, NOT NULL and CHECK declared in DDL and explicitly named. See templates/ecommerce_schema.sql.

step.name: validate-3nf-and-justify-denormalization
step.action: Walk each table: is every non-key column dependent on the whole PK? Where denormalized, write down the query and latency target that justifies it, plus the view or trigger keeping the redundant copy consistent.

step.name: plan-indexes-from-workload
step.action: Run EXPLAIN against representative queries. Add only the indexes the plan demands, and record the index → query mapping.
step.decision-gate: More than ~2 indexes per table on average - re-examine the workload; the schema is probably over-indexed.

step.name: author-migration-plan
step.action: Pick expand-only / expand-then-contract / new-schema. Sequence the DDL statements and write the rollback for each. See templates/alembic_migration.py.
step.decision-gate: Any release containing both an ADD and a DROP - split it before continuing.

step.name: review-and-sign-off
step.action: Open a PR carrying schema spec + ERD + migration plan; DB owner and tech lead review together.

list.item: Named owner has acknowledged the artefact
